responsibility: Implements Rust AST type resolution and related canonicalization utilities. This file resolves type syntax such as arrays, references, raw pointers, slices, tuple and function types, relative and qualified type paths, trait bounds, generic arguments, and where clauses against the current type and name scopes; it also constructs canonical path representations for resolved types and disambiguates generic arguments between type and const forms before recursively resolving them.
same_name_distinction: Implements the type-resolution machinery declared in the header, including relative and qualified type-path lookup, generic-argument disambiguation, type-to-canonical-path conversion, and recursive handling of arrays, references, pointers, slices, and trait-object forms. Unlike the matching header, this file contains the actual type/path resolution algorithms and canonicalization code.
